title: On the entropy of a pseudo-density matrix
summary: The pseudo-density matrix (PDM) formalism naturally extends the notion of density operator to the spatiotemporal domain. While PDMs are Hermitian and of unit trace, they admit negative eigenvalues when encoding temporal correlations unattainable for spacelike separated systems.
